name: G
title: BJJ Coach
bio: Gonzalo is a BJJ Brown Belt with years of experience in both training and gym management. Previously, G managed one of the oldest MMA gyms in the Portland area, gaining invaluable insight into the local martial arts community. As a gym manager, G is dedicated to creating a supportive environment where individuals of all levels can grow in their fitness and BJJ journey.
excerpt: BJJ Brown Belt with years of experience in training, coaching, and martial arts gym management.
